name: カフェ
description: Inside a cozy cafe with a wooden floor. A waiter in a black apron is walking with a tray of two cups of coffee. A man in a blue shirt has knocked over his coffee cup, and the coffee is spilling off the table onto the floor. He is raising his hand in surprise. A woman in a yellow sweater is typing on a laptop at a table by the window, and a small dog is sleeping under her table. A girl in a red dress is eating a piece of strawberry cake, and her mother is taking a picture of the cake with her phone. Behind the counter, a barista in a green apron is making coffee with an espresso machine. On the counter there is a glass case with cakes and a cash register. There is a chalkboard menu on the wall, three lamps hanging from a beam, big windows with plants, a coat rack, and an empty table with flowers.
